ui.purpose: All running UI: labels, body, section titles, headings. Never uppercase-stamp-only text.

headline.purpose: The one bold headline per screen, inside TicketHeader.

stamp.purpose: Ink-stamp contexts only: StateStamp, Badge, CancelledStampOverlay, numeric-count contexts. Never page or section headings.

mono.purpose: Ticket/correlativo codes and station icon numerals — the stamped serial-number read.

shadows.name: step-offset
shadows.purpose: Flat hard-edged 'step' shadow under TicketHeader and above barra-acciones; never blurred.

shadows.name: stamp-lift
shadows.purpose: Isolated blurred shadow on StateStamp only, simulating physical ink-stamp lift.

motion.name: stamp-thud
motion.purpose: Ink-stamp impact on StateStamp mount: oversized+transparent enter, slight undershoot settle. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: fold-open
motion.purpose: FoldPanel real paper-fold disclosure via rotateX/perspective, not a scaleY accordion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid carbon-ink action button; hover inverts to outline.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 80ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn--primary { border: 2px solid #23241f; background: #23241f; color: #ecede6; } .ds-btn--primary:hover { background: transparent; color: #23241f; } .ds-btn--primary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid #b3501e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline action button for secondary/exporting actions.
components.css: .ds-btn--secondary { border: 2px solid #82866f; background: transparent; color: #23241f; } .ds-btn--secondary:hover { border-color: #23241f; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Rotated ink-stamp status marker, used inline in lists/tables for Mapa Murino status wherever it appears off the map.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 3px 10px 4px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-4deg); } .ds-badge--verde { background: #eef3ea; color: #2f6b3e; }

components.name: State Stamp
components.description: Large block-level ink stamp for a document's lifecycle state; thuds into place on state change.
components.css: .ds-state-stamp { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 22px; border: 3px solid currentColor; border-radius: 3px; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-7deg); box-shadow: 1px 2px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18); } .ds-state-stamp--aprobado { color: #2f6b3e; } @keyframes ds-stamp-thud { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-7deg) scale(1.8); } 60% { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(-7deg) scale(0.94); } 100% { transform: rotate(-7deg) scale(1); } } .ds-state-stamp--thud { animation: ds-stamp-thud 220ms cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.2, 0.5, 1); }

components.name: Cancelled Stamp Overlay
components.description: Diagonal cancellation band over an OBSERVADO document; overlays without hiding the record beneath.
components.css: .ds-cancel-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; z-index: 5; } .ds-cancel-overlay__banda { position: absolute; top: 46%; left: -12%; width: 124%; padding: 10px 0; transform: rotate(-9deg); border-top: 3px solid #b3501e; border-bottom: 3px solid #b3501e; background: rgba(179, 80, 30, 0.14); color: #b3501e; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(20px, 3vw, 30px); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Ticket Header
components.description: Sticky per-screen header carrying ticket code, title, and identity meta line, per the 'identity never leaves view' invariant.
components.css: .ds-ticket-header { position: sticky; top: 0; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 20px 16px; background: #f4f5ef; border-bottom: 2px solid #23241f; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #a8ab9b; } .ds-ticket-header__code { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #837e6c; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-ticket-header__title { margin: 2px 0 0; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(19px, 2.6vw, 25px); line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-ticket-header__meta { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: #56564b; }

components.name: Fold Panel
components.description: Progressive disclosure for dense records via a real rotateX/perspective paper fold, not an accordion.
components.html: Contenido plegado…
components.css: .ds-fold-panel { border: 1.5px solid #82866f; border-radius: 2px; background: #ecede6; } .ds-fold-panel__pull { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; background: none; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: #23241f; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-fold-panel__tab { width: 10px; height: 14px; background: #837e6c; border-radius: 1px; transition: transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-fold-panel--open .ds-fold-panel__tab { transform: rotate(90deg); background: #23241f; } .ds-fold-panel__crease { height: 0; margin: 0 16px; border-top: 1px dashed #a8ab9b; } .ds-fold-panel__stage { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr; perspective: 900px; transition: grid-template-rows 220ms ease-out; } .ds-fold-panel--open .ds-fold-panel__stage { grid-template-rows: 1fr; } .ds-fold-panel__body { transform-origin: top; transform: rotateX(-90deg); opacity: 0; padding: 4px 16px 16px; transition: transform 220ms ease-out, opacity 180ms ease-out; } .ds-fold-panel--open .ds-fold-panel__body { transform: rotateX(0deg); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Station Tag
components.description: Rodent-control station off the map: icon shows last-visit state, surrounding row floods solid with the 4-visit trend aura color.
components.css: .ds-station-tag { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1.5px solid #82866f; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-station-tag__icono { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2.5px solid currentColor; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; } .ds-station-tag__icono--rojo { color: #9c2c21; } .ds-station-tag__label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-station-tag--rojo { background: #9c2c21; color: #fbe9e6; border-color: #9c2c21; }

components.name: Perforated Divider
components.description: Dashed tear-line separating every row of a list, the pre-cut ticket-stub motif.

narrative.northStar: Garita de control industrial (the checkpoint gate-pass)
narrative.overview: GAFER's UI treats every client, service, and inspection as a pass through a checkpoint, not a record softly "created" in a dashboard. Kraft-cardstock surfaces, carbon ink rules, ticket-stub headers, and rotated ink-stamp badges replace the generic SaaS vocabulary of pastel pills and floating cards. Nothing here is decorative texture: the ground is cool-grey industrial kraft (confirmed and retuned during the build to read as cardstock, never bakery cream), and the four safety-system colors — verified green, warning amber, alert orange, danger red — are load-bearing twice over: they are both the brand accent set and the literal VERDE/AMARILLO/NARANJA/ROJO Mapa Murino status vocabulary, required by product to read identically on the map, on badges, on lists, and on dashboards. The system is deliberately flat and hairline-ruled rather than shadowed or gradiented — depth reads through boxed compartments and rule weight, not elevation. Two roles get two working modes on the same token set: dense, scan-and-decide tables and panels for desk use; large touch targets (44px minimum) and single-column stacking under 480px for gloved, sunlit field use. Motion is a small, literal vocabulary — an ink-stamp thud, a real paper fold, a solid color flood — never generic easing or a bouncy micro-interaction library.
keyCharacteristics: Kraft/carbon industrial ground with hairline box-rules; no soft cards, no drop shadows as an ambient default.
Status color doubles as brand color: the same four hues carry Mapa Murino state everywhere they appear.
State is a rotated ink-stamp, never a pill; cancellation is a diagonal overlay banding across the record, not a replaced badge.
Three-typeface role split: grotesk for running UI/headings, slab-display strictly for stamps/badges/counts, monospace for ticket codes.
A fixed ticket-stub header (ticket code · title · meta) opens every screen.

rules.name: The Status-Is-Brand Rule
rules.body: VERDE/AMARILLO/NARANJA/ROJO are never "just an accent" — they are simultaneously the Mapa Murino trend vocabulary and the only saturated colors in the system. A new status-bearing surface reuses these four hues; it never introduces a fifth "brand" color.

rules.name: The Solid Flood Rule
rules.body: Escalating state on a StationTag floods the entire card in the solid status color (background + border + ink-contrast text), not a tinted accent or a colored dot.

rules.name: The Stamp-Face Containment Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders Display renders only inside StateStamp, Badge, and CancelledStampOverlay (plus the station-tag icon numeral, which uses mono, not stamp). It never appears on a page heading, section title, or body copy — a defect from an earlier build pass, corrected before this documentation.

rules.name: The Ticket-Code Rule
rules.body: Any human-facing correlativo or ticket identifier renders in JetBrains Mono at reduced size and faint ink color — it reads as a stamped-on serial number, distinct from both prose and stamp text.

rules.name: The Flat-Ledger Rule
rules.body: Panels and headers are flat at rest; the only depth cues are rule-weight borders and hard color-offset "step" shadows (never blurred, except on the stamp itself). Do not add ambient box-shadow blur to cards, panels, or buttons.

dos: Do treat status color as brand color: reuse VERDE/AMARILLO/NARANJA/ROJO/SIN_COLOR everywhere a state or trend appears, through Badge/StationTag/StateStamp, never a bespoke inline color.
Do render state as a rotated ink-stamp (Badge, StateStamp) — border in currentColor, stamp-face type, fixed negative tilt — never a rounded pastel pill.
Do flood the entire element in solid status color for an escalating/aura state (StationTag), not a tinted accent or soft gradient.
Do open every screen with a TicketHeader carrying a mono ticket code, a bold title, and an identity meta line.
Do separate list rows with the dashed PerforatedDivider, never a plain solid rule or bare gap.
Do keep touch targets at 44px minimum and collapse multi-column grids to one column under 480px, honoring the field/gloved-use constraint from PRODUCT.md.
donts: Don't use Big Shoulders Display (the stamp face) outside StateStamp, Badge, CancelledStampOverlay, or numeric/count contexts — it does not belong on page or section headings (Archivo carries those), a defect corrected during finish review.
Don't add ambient blurred box-shadow to cards, panels, or buttons — this system is flat by rule; the one blurred shadow (StateStamp) is an isolated physical-stamp exception, not a precedent.

Don't replace a cancelled/rejected document's existing badge with a new one — overlay a diagonal CancelledStampOverlay band on top instead; nothing in this system disappears on rejection, it gets cancelled visibly.
Don't animate disclosure as a generic vertical accordion (scaleY/height-slide) — dense records fold open via FoldPanel's real rotateX/perspective transform.
Don't introduce kicker/eyebrow labels above headings — none exist in the shipped system; a stray one was found and removed during finish review and must not recur.
